description: This source file defines the SeriesElements class within the PdfSharp.Charting namespace, representing a collection of data series points in a charting library. It provides methods for adding points, cloning, and accessing points by index, encapsulating collection behaviors for chart data series.

classes.name: SeriesElements
classes.description: Represents a collection of data points in a chart series, allowing access, addition, and cloning of points.
